experimental_scope: same frozen packet; before prompt+verifier vs after prompt+verifier; optional routing bypassed for isolated evaluation only

matched_pairs.rule: Both arms must have valid schema and stop finish; all other pairs excluded symmetrically.

exploratory_sentence_coverage.method: Post-hoc deterministic sentence splitting and facet regex, exact quote coverage only, not human semantic labels; does not replace preregistered whole-span metric.

costs.basis: Known OpenRouter response usage.cost only; unknown calls are not zero-cost. Excludes payment/funding fees.

interpretation: Quoted-unit coverage is mechanical, not semantic recall/precision. Raw model output and accepted review candidates are separate. No candidate is a saved/verified memory.
